name: SciERC violation rate (minimal prompt)
description: Zero-shot Qwen3-8B on SciERC with minimal task prompt, measuring baseline ontology constraint violation rates across 7 relation types
tables: Table 1: Per-relation violation rates (7 rows × columns: relation, |triples|, DR rate, constraint tightness τ)
analysis:
审稿人评价：'The violation landscape study (§3) is a valuable empirical contribution in its own right — prior work assumes violations exist but never quantifies their distribution across relation types.' Novelty score 3.5+ 因为这是 first systematic measurement。Evaluate-for 24.1% 和 Compare 42.4% 的高违规率直接 motivate 了 decoding-time enforcement 的必要性。

15.4% overall DR with massive per-relation variance (0.8%–42.4%) is the ideal setup for the paper's tightness hypothesis。审稿人看到 7-relation ontology 产生 15.4% DR（与 96-relation DocRED 的 18.7% 可比）时，'violation rate driven by tightness not size' 的 insight 立即成立。Compare (42.4%) 和 Used-for (0.8%) 的 56× 差距是极具说服力的 motivating example。在 best 档，至少 2/3 审稿人将此 landscape study 视为独立 empirical contribution——它回答了'LLM-based IE 到底在哪里、多严重地违反 ontology constraints'这一此前未系统回答的问题。

name: SciERC violation rate (schema-informed prompt)
description: Zero-shot Qwen3-8B on SciERC with schema-informed prompt explicitly describing domain/range constraints
tables: Table 2: Per-relation DR before/after schema-informed prompt (7 rows × columns: relation, DR_minimal, DR_schema, Δpp, direction)
analysis:
审稿人评价：'The observation that schema-informed prompting can *increase* violations for specific relations (Evaluate-for: +5.8pp) is compelling evidence that prompt-level intervention is not merely weak but unpredictable.' 这使 Claim 2 从 'obvious' 升级为 'insightful'——不仅仅是'prompt 不够'，而是'prompt 在特定 constraint configuration 下 actively harmful'。

62.4% overall reduction 表面看很好，但 Evaluate-for 的 regression (+5.8pp) 是关键 finding。在 best 档，审稿人将此理解为 'prompt-level intervention is fundamentally unreliable as a guarantee mechanism'——不仅 insufficient，而且 per-relation 不可预测甚至 counterproductive。Prior-constraint conflict 解释（schema prompt 干扰模型 type assignment）被视为 deeper insight 而非 post-hoc excuse。这为 Claim 2 提供了从'statistically insufficient'到'mechanistically unreliable'的升级论据。3 个 relation 仍保留 >10% violation rate 的事实让 'safety-critical IE needs guaranteed compliance' 的论点不可反驳。

name: DocRED violation rate (minimal prompt)
description: Zero-shot Qwen3-8B on DocRED (96 relations) with minimal prompt, measuring violation rates on complex ontology
tables: Table 1 (extended): DocRED violation summary alongside SciERC for direct comparison
analysis:
审稿人评价：'The fact that a 7-relation ontology (SciERC, 15.4%) and a 96-relation ontology (DocRED, 18.7%) produce comparable violation rates is strong evidence for the tightness hypothesis. This is a non-obvious finding — one might expect more relations = more confusion = more violations.' 这成为 §3 的 headline finding。

DocRED DR 18.7% 与 SciERC 15.4% 的 comparable rate（尽管 ontology 规模差 14×）是 tightness hypothesis 的 killer evidence。在 best 档，审稿人直接认可 'violation rate is driven by constraint tightness, not ontology size'。RV 28.9% 揭示了 LLM 生成大量 OOV relation names 的严重问题——这同时 motivates grammar 层的必要性。P31_instance_of 60.4% DR rate 说明即使最常见的 relation 也可以有极高违规率（因其 domain 限制为特定 entity types），进一步支持 tightness 论点。

name: DocRED violation rate (schema-informed prompt)
description: Zero-shot Qwen3-8B on DocRED with schema-informed prompt, testing prompt intervention scalability
tables: Table 2 (panel b): DocRED prompt intervention summary
analysis:
审稿人评价：'The reduced effectiveness of schema-informed prompting on DocRED (32% vs 62% on SciERC) demonstrates that prompt-level intervention does not scale with ontology complexity — precisely the regime where guaranteed compliance is most needed.' 审稿人在 Claim 2 的 soundness score 给 4.0+。

DocRED schema-informed prompt 仅达到 32% DR reduction（vs SciERC 的 62.4%）——这是 'prompt-level intervention scales poorly with ontology complexity' 的直接证据。在 best 档，审稿人将 SciERC 62% vs DocRED 32% 的对比视为 prompt approach 的 fundamental scalability limit，而非实验 noise。96 relations 的 constraint descriptions 放入 prompt 后，模型无法有效利用全部信息——这是 attention/context window 的固有限制，不可能通过更好的 prompt engineering 解决。这为 decoding-time enforcement 的 motivation 提供了 scalability argument。

name: SciERC unconstrained baseline
description: Phase 2 re-run of unconstrained SciERC with v2 checker for exact apples-to-apples comparison
analysis:
作为 ablation table 的 baseline row，所有 Δ 值从此计算。审稿人验证了 F1 计算方法（all_set：OOV predictions 计入 denominator）是合理的——它让 grammar 层的 OOV elimination 体现为 F1 gain 而非被忽略。

与 P001 完全一致的结果（同一 inference output，只是用 v2 checker 重新计算）确认了 checker 修正后 baseline 数字不变，实验可复现性无问题。在 best 档，审稿人注意到所有 ablation 用同一 checker version (v2) 计算，methodology 被视为 rigorous。json_parse_rate=100% 说明 Qwen3-8B 在 SciERC prompt 下输出格式完美——unconstrained 不需要 grammar 来保证 JSON 合法性，grammar 层的价值在于 vocabulary/type constraint。

name: SciERC grammar-only
description: SciERC with only grammar layer (XGrammar CFG): enforces JSON structure + valid relation/entity type vocabulary
analysis:
审稿人评价：'The grammar-only ablation demonstrates that structural constraints (vocabulary enforcement) are necessary but insufficient — domain/range violations require the stateful semantic layer. This cleanly separates the two layers' roles.' DR 几乎不降说明 random valid relation name 被 grammar 强制分配时，type constraint 仍然被违反——grammar 不理解 semantics。

Grammar 层完美消除 ET 和 RV（→0%），但 DR 几乎不变（14.84% vs 15.37%，Δ-0.53pp）。这是 enabling dependency 论证的关键一半：grammar 确保 relation name 合法，使 semantic 层可以查表执行 domain/range 约束——但 grammar 本身不知道什么 entity type 可以填什么 relation slot。在 best 档，审稿人将此解读为 clean ablation evidence：'Grammar provides structural prerequisite but not semantic enforcement.' SciERC RV baseline 仅 1.39%，所以 grammar 在 SciERC 上 F1 impact 可忽略（Δ-0.03pp），但 DocRED RV 29.66% 时 grammar 是 F1 gain 的唯一来源。

name: SciERC semantic-only
description: SciERC with only semantic layer (TypeConstraintProcessor): enforces domain/range via entity registry + logit masking, without grammar vocabulary constraint
analysis:
审稿人评价：'The dramatic difference between semantic-only (↓24%) and full system (↓94%) is the strongest evidence that grammar is an enabling prerequisite, not merely an additive component. This is a genuine architectural insight distinguishing OntoCoDec from systems like SynCode that operate a single constraint layer.' Novelty perception 提升——不是简单的 'apply CFG to IE' 而是 'design a two-layer system with principled dependency structure'。

Semantic-only DR=11.65%（仅↓24% vs baseline 15.37%）——远低于 full_s1 的↓94%。这是 enabling dependency 的 smoking gun：当 RV≠0（semantic-only 允许 OOV relation names），semantic 层遇到未知 relation 时无法查表获得 domain/range 约束，退化为 no-op。在 best 档，审稿人将 24% vs 94% 的对比视为 'compelling evidence for the enabling dependency architecture — grammar is a prerequisite for semantic, not an independent parallel system。' 这区分了 OntoCoDec 与 naive 'apply two masks independently' 的关键 architectural insight，被审稿人视为论文的 non-trivial contribution。CF 从 0.08% 升至 2.71% 预示了 semantic enforcement 引入 CF 的 trade-off，但在 best 档 审稿人在此阶段只是 note 它。

name: SciERC full S1
description: SciERC with both grammar + semantic layers in single-pass (S1): the primary recommended configuration
tables: Table 4: Bootstrap CI results — R-F1 95% CI [-0.32, +0.58], p=0.58
analysis:
审稿人评价：'94% reduction in domain/range violations with statistically neutral F1 impact is a strong result. The residual 0.93% is well-explained by the decidability taxonomy (§4.3) — these are genuinely non-local constraints beyond the scope of forward-only decoding.' Soundness score 4.0+ 因为 ablation 干净、CI 提供、residual 有理论解释。

DR 15.37%→0.93%（↓94%）at R-F1 +0.13pp (p=0.58, not significant) 是论文的 headline result。在 best 档，审稿人将此解读为：(1) near-complete DR elimination，(2) zero F1 cost（p=0.58 确认 noise），(3) 干净的方法学贡献而非 cherry-picked 数字。CF 9.9% 被正面对待因为论文主动披露 + 提供 root cause analysis (type ambiguity in SciERC) + 消融归因 (100% 由 semantic 层引入)。审稿人评论 'refreshingly honest' 关于 CF 的处理。Residual DR 0.93%（16/1729 triples）在 best 档被接受为'near-complete'——审稿人理解 forward-only decoding 的 fundamental limitation (truly non-local constraints undecidable)。

name: SciERC full S2 (ablation)
description: SciERC with two-pass strategy: Pass 1 grammar-only entity extraction, Pass 2 entity-conditioned relation generation
tables: Appendix Table: S1 vs S2 detailed comparison
analysis:
审稿人评价：'S2 demonstrates that the framework supports alternative decoding strategies, though S1 is correctly identified as superior. The honest reporting that S2 does not meaningfully reduce CF is appreciated.' 这作为 §5 ablation 或 Appendix B 出现。不占正文空间过多，但展示了 framework 的 composability。

S2 DR=0.97% ≈ S1 0.93%，CF=8.03% vs S1 9.90%（Δ-1.87pp, not significant）。在 best 档，审稿人接受 S2 作为 architectural variant demonstrating framework flexibility，而非核心贡献。S2 没有解决 CF 的事实被诚实报告——审稿人评价 'The authors correctly position S2 as an architectural ablation rather than overclaiming CF mitigation.' S2 R-F1=8.03% 略低于 S1 8.36%（Δ-0.33pp）进一步支持了 S1 作为 recommended configuration 的选择。在 best 档这被视为 thorough engineering exploration 而非 weakness。

name: DocRED unconstrained baseline
description: Qwen3-8B on DocRED (96 relations) unconstrained, establishing violation baseline for complex ontology
analysis:
审稿人注意到 RV 29.66% 远高于 SciERC 1.39%——这解释了为什么 grammar 层在 DocRED 上产生显著 F1 gain（消除 OOV = 消除 FP）而在 SciERC 上 F1 neutral。model-dataset interaction 被视为 insightful analysis。

RV 29.66% 是 DocRED 的 defining pathology——模型生成大量不存在于 ontology 中的 relation names（5189 instances）。在 best 档，审稿人将此视为 grammar 层在 complex ontology 下 critical importance 的明确证据。ET 2.48% 说明模型也生成非法 entity types。all_set F1 方法将这些 OOV predictions 计入 denominator（penalize them as FP），所以 grammar 消除 OOV 后 F1 提升是 methodologically correct 而非 artifact。这组 baseline 数字建立了 DocRED 作为'high-violation-rate complex ontology'的定位，与 SciERC 的'small but tight ontology'形成互补 test bed。

name: DocRED grammar-only
description: DocRED with grammar layer only: enforcing valid relation vocabulary + entity type vocabulary via CFG
analysis:
审稿人评价：'The counterintuitive finding that grammar-only *increases* DR (18.46%→26.17%) is well-explained: OOV relations masked constraint violations by lacking defined domain/range rules. Grammar exposes these latent violations. This is a key insight for understanding the interaction between vocabulary and semantic constraints.' 这直接支持 enabling dependency narrative 并解释了 Qwen DocRED full_s1 DR↓45% (not ↓94%) 的原因。

Grammar 层将 RV 从 29.66% 压到 0.03%，ET 从 2.48% 压到 0%——但 DR 从 18.46% 升至 26.17%（+7.71pp）。这个 DR 上升是 best 档审稿人特别欣赏的 finding：grammar 强制 OOV relation names 映射到 valid vocabulary，但随机映射的 valid relation name 往往与 entity types 不匹配 → 暴露大量 latent DR violations。在 best 档，审稿人将此解读为 'grammar reveals latent violations that were previously hidden behind OOV names — these triples were already semantically invalid but the invalidity was masked by the OOV relation name not having defined domain/range constraints。' 这是 D014 tightness × RV baseline 双因子分析的核心数据点。E-F1 59.38% 显著高于 unconstrained 58.15%（+1.23pp, p<0.001）——grammar 是 F1 gain 的唯一来源（full_s1 E-F1=59.37% ≈ grammar_only）。

name: DocRED semantic-only
description: DocRED with semantic layer only: TypeConstraintProcessor enforces domain/range without grammar vocabulary constraint
analysis:
审稿人评价：'Consistent ~25% DR reduction for semantic-only across both datasets (SciERC 24%, DocRED 25%) provides robust evidence that the enabling dependency is a general architectural property, not dataset-specific.' Semantic 层的 partial effectiveness 精确匹配了 'only enforceable on known relations' 的理论预测。

Semantic-only DR=13.84%（↓25% from 18.46%）——与 SciERC semantic-only ↓24% 高度一致。在 best 档，审稿人将两个数据集上 semantic-only 都只能降 ~25% 的一致性视为 enabling dependency 的 robust evidence：'Regardless of ontology complexity, semantic constraints alone achieve only modest DR reduction because ~30% of relations are OOV and cannot be constraint-checked.' RV 仍然 29.87%（几乎不变于 baseline 29.66%）——semantic 层不处理 vocabulary。ET 实际升至 4.22%（from 2.48%）可能是 semantic masking 的副作用，但在 best 档 审稿人不 flag 这个因为 full system ET=0%。

name: DocRED full S1
description: DocRED with full grammar+semantic S1: the primary configuration on complex ontology
analysis:
审稿人评价：'The authors provide a principled explanation for the reduced DR elimination on DocRED (45% vs 94% on SciERC) through the tightness×RV baseline interaction. This dual-factor analysis (§5.2) transforms what could be perceived as a weakness into a deeper insight about constraint enforcement dynamics. The significant F1 improvement (p<0.001) is a bonus, correctly attributed to OOV elimination rather than semantic constraint quality.' Soundness score 4.0+。

DR 18.46%→10.21%（↓44.7%）+ R-F1 +0.50pp (p<0.001) + E-F1 +1.23pp (p<0.001)。在 best 档，审稿人对 Qwen DocRED ↓45%（vs SciERC ↓94%）的'较弱'reduction 的理解是关键。D014 dual-factor analysis 提供了完整解释：Qwen RV baseline 29.66% → grammar 暴露大量 latent DR → residual DR 更高。审稿人将此解读为 'the method works as theoretically predicted — weaker reduction on DocRED is explained by the RV×tightness interaction, not method failure。' Cross-model validation (Llama DocRED ↓90.2%) 进一步证实方法本身有效，Qwen 的 weaker reduction 是 model-specific RV pathology。F1 gain 被归因于 OOV elimination（grammar 层功劳），如实报告不升级为 core claim。CF=2.57% 远低于 SciERC 9.9%——审稿人注意到 CF 与 ontology tightness 正相关。

name: Llama SciERC unconstrained
description: Llama-3.1-8B on SciERC unconstrained, establishing cross-model baseline
analysis:
审稿人评价：'The cross-model validation is commendable — testing on Llama-3.1-8B without any code modification demonstrates the framework's model-agnosticism. The different violation profiles (Llama: lower RV, lower overall DR) set up the model-interaction analysis that follows.' 零代码修改是 strong engineering claim。

Llama DR=13.34% vs Qwen DR=15.37%——不同模型有不同的 violation profile 但 non-trivial rates are universal。Llama RV=0.55%（很低，类似 Qwen SciERC 1.39%）预示了 full_s1 将有极高 DR reduction（因为 grammar 不需要暴露 latent violations）。在 best 档，审稿人将 cross-model baseline 视为 rigorous experimental design：'Testing on a second model family (Llama vs Qwen) with zero code modification demonstrates the method is model-agnostic by design.' Llama 较低的 absolute F1（R-F1 2.68% vs Qwen 8.23%）被理解为 model capability difference 而非 constraint method issue——zero-shot R-F1 is control variable not optimization target。

name: Llama SciERC full S1
description: Llama-3.1-8B on SciERC with full grammar+semantic S1, zero code modification
tables: Table 8: Cross-model summary — DR reduction rates
analysis:
审稿人评价：'99.4% DR reduction on Llama-3.1-8B with zero code modification is the most compelling evidence for model-agnosticism. The near-perfect elimination (1 residual violation out of 1315 triples) approaches the theoretical limit of forward-only decoding.' 这与 Qwen 94% 形成互补——不同模型不同 reduction rate 但都 substantial，且差异被 RV baseline 理论解释。

DR 13.34%→0.08%（↓99.4%）是全矩阵中最高的 reduction rate。在 best 档，审稿人将 99.4% 解读为'near-perfect constraint enforcement on a different model family'。R-F1 -0.14pp (p=0.011) technically significant 但 magnitude negligible（0.14pp on a ~2.7% baseline = 5% relative）。审稿人在 best 档接受这是 'statistically detectable but practically negligible' 的 F1 cost。DR 0.08%（仅 1 triple out of 1315）接近 theoretical minimum。CF 6.56% 高于 Qwen SciERC（与 paper framing 一致：'non-local constraint problem is more pronounced on Llama'），在 limitations 中提及。关键：这个实验用与 Qwen 完全相同的 grammar/semantic 配置——'zero code modification' claim 被实证验证。

name: Llama DocRED unconstrained
description: Llama-3.1-8B on DocRED unconstrained, establishing complex ontology × different model baseline
analysis:
审稿人评价：'The orthogonal RV-DR profiles between Qwen (high RV, moderate DR) and Llama (low RV, high DR) on the same ontology is a valuable finding — it demonstrates that the two constraint layers address genuinely independent failure modes. This justifies the two-layer architecture from an empirical, not just theoretical, perspective.' D014 insight 被 validated。

Llama DocRED DR=26.07% >> Qwen DocRED DR=18.46%——不同模型在同一 ontology 上有显著不同的 violation profile。但 Llama RV=16.03% << Qwen RV=29.66%。在 best 档，审稿人将此 RV↓DR↑ 的正交性视为 §5 cross-model 的独立 finding：'vocabulary compliance ≠ semantic compliance——a model can produce valid relation names (low RV) while still violating domain/range constraints at high rates (high DR)。' 这证明两层约束解决正交的 failure modes。Parse failures 68/998=6.8% 高于 Qwen 12/998=1.2%——bias 方向保守（fewer docs checked → constrained 有效性被 underestimated if anything）。

name: Llama DocRED full S1
description: Llama-3.1-8B on DocRED with full grammar+semantic S1, testing scalability to complex ontology × different model
tables: Table 8: Full 2×2 cross-model × cross-dataset matrix summary
analysis:
审稿人评价：'The complete 2-model × 2-dataset matrix with substantial DR reductions across all cells (45%–99.4%) is convincing generalization evidence. The variation in reduction rates is well-explained by the tightness×RV interaction model, demonstrating principled understanding rather than ad-hoc tuning. The framework achieves this with zero code modification across models — a strong engineering contribution.' 这满足了 '3 模型 × 2 数据集矩阵被视为充分 generalization 证据' 的 best 档条件（注：第 3 模型 Mistral 在 FT ablation 中补全）。

DR 26.07%→2.55%（↓90.2%）完成了 2×2 矩阵的最后一格。在 best 档，审稿人将 4 格矩阵视为充分的 generalization evidence：Qwen SciERC ↓94%, Qwen DocRED ↓45%, Llama SciERC ↓99.4%, Llama DocRED ↓90.2%——全部 substantial reduction。Llama DocRED ↓90.2% vs Qwen DocRED ↓45% 的巨大差异被 RV baseline 理论完美解释（Llama RV=16% low → grammar 不暴露太多 latent DR → semantic 可高效执行）。R-F1 +0.29pp (p=0.013, significant) 是 'no F1 cost' 的进一步确认——实际有 small gain。E-F1 -0.64pp (p=0.022) 是唯一的 modest decline——在 best 档被接受为 'model-dependent, small magnitude, within acceptable range'。CF=12.02% 是全矩阵最高值——Llama 在 DocRED 上更容易产生 entity-vs-relation type drift。在 best 档 limitations 中如实报告，审稿人评价 'acceptable given the CF is a known limitation of per-relation enforcement'。

name: S2 pilot (50 docs)
description: Small-scale pilot of S2 two-pass strategy on 50 SciERC documents
analysis:
不出现在论文正文。如果 appendix 包含开发 timeline，可简要提及 'pilot validation confirmed implementation correctness before full evaluation'。在 best 档审稿人不会质疑这个。

Pilot 确认了 S2 implementation 可工作（DR 2.05%），但小样本 artifact 不可用于 claim。在 best 档，审稿人不会看到这个实验的数据——它仅作为 engineering validation 在开发过程中使用。Paper 只报告 full S2 run (P008, n=551)。如果审稿人在 appendix 看到 pilot 数据，会理解为 'standard engineering practice of pilot testing before full run'。关键：pilot DR=2.05% 与 full run DR=0.97% 的差异仅因样本量，不构成 concern。

name: Post-hoc filtering baseline
description: Post-hoc filtering comparison: remove all violated triples from unconstrained output and re-evaluate F1
tables: Table 9: OntoCoDec vs Post-hoc multi-dimensional comparison (precision, recall, rejection rate, TP lost, ET residual)
analysis:
审稿人评价：'The post-hoc baseline is well-designed and honestly reported — the authors acknowledge post-hoc achieves higher precision while correctly arguing that (1) it cannot prevent violations during generation, only detect them after, (2) the 48% rejection rate is unacceptable for many applications, and (3) it cannot address entity-type violations at all. The 'prevent vs detect' framing is appropriate.' 这个 baseline 的存在本身被视为 thorough experimental design——'the authors anticipated this obvious comparison and addressed it systematically'。

Post-hoc F1 > OntoCoDec F1（SciERC 8.63 vs 8.36, DocRED 9.61 vs 8.23）。在 best 档，审稿人接受论文的 multi-dimensional framing 而不简单以 F1 论高低。关键论据层次：(1) Recall 维度——OntoCoDec recall 上升（probability mass redistribution 生效），post-hoc recall 下降（误删正确 triples）；(2) Information coverage——DocRED post-hoc 丢弃 48.1% triples（近半数信息丢失），无法接受 for completeness-critical applications；(3) ET residual——post-hoc 无法解决 entity type 违规（残余 ET=2.47% DocRED），OntoCoDec ET=0%；(4) 127 个 lost TP 是正确提取但 entity type 违规的 triple——OntoCoDec 通过生成时强制合法 type 保留它们。在 best 档，审稿人评价：'The comparison is fair and multi-dimensional. Post-hoc achieves higher precision through aggressive filtering, but the 48.1% rejection rate and recall loss make it unsuitable for applications requiring completeness.' 这足以 defend against C2 reviewer concern。

name: Bootstrap CI (10000 iterations)
description: Bootstrap confidence intervals (10000 resamples) for all F1 delta claims, providing statistical rigor
tables: Table 10: Bootstrap CI summary for all F1 claims (Δ, 95% CI, p-value, interpretation)
analysis:
审稿人评价：'The bootstrap confidence intervals are appropriately computed and correctly interpreted — the authors distinguish between statistical significance and practical relevance (Llama SciERC: p=0.011 but Δ=0.14pp is negligible). This level of statistical rigor exceeds most NLP papers.' Soundness score 直接受益于此——无 reviewer 需要质疑 'is this improvement real?'

Bootstrap CI 为每个 F1 claim 提供了统计保障。在 best 档，审稿人将 10000-iteration bootstrap 视为 gold standard statistical practice：(1) SciERC p=0.58 明确标记为 'neutral' 而非 overclaim improvement；(2) DocRED p<0.001 with CI entirely above zero 支持 'significant improvement' 声明；(3) Llama SciERC p=0.011 with magnitude 0.14pp 被正确标记为 'negligible'——作者区分了 statistical significance 和 practical significance。在 best 档，这种 calibrated statistical reporting 被视为 methodological rigor 的 evidence。审稿人不需要质疑任何 F1 claim 的 validity 因为 CI 和 p-values 全部提供。

name: DocRED schema compilation (Phase 0 R2)
description: Second attempt at DocRED schema-informed prompt compilation (killed, superseded by P004)
analysis:
不出现在论文中。无审稿人 visibility。

被 P004 替代，不出现在论文中。在 best 档，审稿人完全不会看到这个实验——它是内部开发迭代的产物。killed experiments 的存在说明团队在开发过程中进行了 iterative refinement，但论文只报告 final/correct versions。在 best 档这是完全正常且 expected 的 engineering practice。
